data.summary: next lists a capped item as blocked (held by the parallelism cap; slot offered to a higher-ranked item) while claim never applies the cap to a named item (api/lifecycle/wait.py:108, pinned by test_a_cap_blocked_item_wait_agrees_with_claim). The detail does not say so, and the higher-ranked item can have no lease and an idle lane (DX-wait-cycle-followups, 2026-11-05), so a lane cannot tell whether to wait or claim. The hold should say which applies.
data.title: next reports an item held by the parallelism cap though a named claim is not capped

Fixes bug B30f9d383ba: next lists a capped item as blocked (held by the parallelism cap; slot offered to a higher-ranked item) while claim never applies the cap to a named item (api/lifecycle/wait.py:108, pinned by test_a_cap_blocked_item_wait_agrees_with_claim). The detail does not say so, and the higher-ranked item can have no lease and an idle lane (DX-wait-cycle-followups, 2026-11-05), so a lane cannot tell whether to wait or claim. The hold should say which applies.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B30f9d383ba --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B30f9d383ba --regression-test <test>` first).
data.title: Fix bug B30f9d383ba: next reports an item held by the parallelism cap though a named claim is not capped
